svg.title: Clessidra faceplate, Synthux Simple Touch
svg.desc: 1:1, pt. PCB faceplate, as Synthux's template layers: BG (black mask), Copper (exposed), White (silkscreen). Outline and opening centres from Synthux's Simple Touch Faceplate template (DXF), the outline as its lines and arcs (R 48.48 shoulder, R 3.31 corners). Copper drawn gold for the preview.
